item.title: fix(subagents): wake idle parents after completion (#129993)
item.summary: fix(subagents): wake idle parents after completion (#129993) Carry the exact Gateway owner through detached subagent completion so idle parents receive results without another inbound message. Fence reactivation writes and final agent dispatch when that owner retires. Co-authored-by: Marvinthebored Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
